repositories.name: react
repositories.description: Component-based JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

milestones.title: React open sourced
milestones.description: React was released as open source at JSConf 2013. Facebook engineers shared their internal tool with the world.

milestones.title: React rebuilt from scratch
milestones.description: React 16 launched with a complete internal rewrite. Same API for users, but the engine was entirely rebuilt to be faster and more flexible.

milestones.title: Hooks changed everything
milestones.description: React 16.8 introduced Hooks - a new way to use state and features without writing classes. This became the standard way to write React.

milestones.title: React 19 major update
milestones.description: React 19 brought Server Components and new ways to handle forms and data. Check the next two milestones for data quirks.

milestones.title: Data quirk: code looks different
milestones.description: The data shows weird patterns here because Facebook reorganized their code internally. Old code got re-attributed to new files.

milestones.title: Data quirk: lots missing
milestones.description: This is a data quirk - many years of code seem to vanish. It's just how the data was collected at this point.

repositories.name: numpy
repositories.description: The fundamental package for scientific computing in Python.

milestones.title: NumPy is born
milestones.description: Travis Oliphant merges Numeric and Numarray to create NumPy - the foundation of Python's scientific computing ecosystem.

milestones.title: NumPy 1.0 released
milestones.description: NumPy 1.0 launches as a standalone package, separated from SciPy. This marks the official birth of NumPy as its own library.

milestones.title: Python 2 & 3 unified
milestones.description: Major refactoring to create a unified codebase supporting both Python 2 and Python 3 without 2to3 conversion. Shipped in NumPy 1.8.0 (Oct 2013).

milestones.title: Major features added
milestones.description: NumPy 1.13 brings groundbreaking features: __array_ufunc__, np.block, and 50+ new functions transform the library.

milestones.title: NumPy 2.0 released
milestones.description: First major release since 2006. Massive breaking changes with ABI break, new dtype system, and 10% fewer namespace objects.
